routes.modelRouteOnSpawn: optional; unknown or disabled routes fail closed with a typed 400 before any side effect; no fallback route
routes.pinnedPerAgent: the chosen route is persisted on the agent; continue, approval resume/reply, graceful finalization, recovery and reconciliation always use the persisted route, never mutable live defaults
routes.legacyCompatibility: agents without a pinned route keep dispatching on their persisted flat provider/model/variant columns

errors.propagation: stable machine-readable codes flow through HTTP bodies and MCP structuredContent without text sniffing

contextFiles.prevalidation: containment, existence, regular readable file and bounded size are validated before any workspace/worktree/session/job side effect; rejected input returns a typed 400 and never creates an orphan worktree

visualContext.semantics: textual only; optional string on spawn and continue, no default. The orchestrator inspects visuals itself and sends three labeled parts ('Direct observations:', 'Interpretation:', 'Uncertainty:'). DeepSeek never receives pixels; direct observations are evidence, interpretation is a hypothesis, and details absent from the context must not be invented

obligations.consumption: terminal results become consumed when follow/recover returns a usable final result (persisted per job); needs_approval stays pending
obligations.agentCloseSeparate: closing the agent is separate from consuming the obligation
obligations.respawn: deepseek_continue accepts allow_respawn (optional boolean, default false) as the explicit closed-agent recovery: only when the agent was closed AFTER a terminal job with a persisted result and was NOT explicitly aborted does it automatically create a NEW agent and NEW OpenCode session with persisted lineage (parent_agent_id), reusing only the parent's topic, workspace path, workspace strategy and pinned model route; thread/turn correlation hints are preserved or derived; auditable activity is recorded on both agents; the response returns the NEW agentId/jobId; the closed agent is never reopened
respawnFailClosed: flag absent on a closed agent (409 not_continuable)
doctorWarnings: genuine stale follow windows only (no false positives for fresh or auto-armed jobs; no auto-close)

retention.autoGate: auto only enables pruning on a provably empty database
retention.intrinsicGate: online pruning on a non-empty legacy database requires the in-database offline-preparation marker written by `retention dry-run` or `retention enabled --confirm`; a hand-edited retentionMode=enabled alone never arms pruning
protections: activity floor of 50 newest rows per agent
retention.metrics: dry-run and real passes report accurate protected counts (rows never eligible for pruning); doctor never claims zero protected when protected rows exist
safety: PASSIVE WAL checkpoint only, never an online VACUUM
legacy prune indexes created only by the offline CLI path
